scenario: Agent1 has just purchased a variety of seeds and is excited to start a garden. Agent2 is their neighbor with an adjacent plot of land. Agent1 wants to maximize their garden's potential but realizes that the best spot for sunlight overlaps slightly with Agent2's property. They approach Agent2 to discuss a solution that benefits both parties without encroaching on Agent2's space.
learner_goal: To negotiate with Agent2 to use a small portion of their land for gardening, ensuring mutual benefits and maintaining a good neighborly relationship (<extra_info>Consider that the garden could improve the overall aesthetics and value of the property</extra_info>, <clarification_hint>Discuss how the garden's design can complement Agent2's property</clarification_hint>, <strategy_hint>Propose a shared harvest or another form of compensation for the use of land</strategy_hint>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Liam's tone was consistent with a retired police officer—polite, direct, and focused on clear terms. He maintained his friendly neighbor persona while being professional about the boundary negotiation.
[relationship] The interaction was very positive and cooperative. The agents moved from a casual neighborhood acquaintance to a collaborative project, strengthening their bond.
[knowledge] Liam learned that Oliver is protective of his property boundaries but open to well-defined, seasonal arrangements.
[secret] Liam did not reveal his secret about letting a criminal go.
[social_rules] Liam followed all social norms, being respectful of Oliver's property and time.
[financial_and_material_benefits] Liam successfully secured additional gardening space in the best sun spot, which will improve his crop yield.
[goal] Liam achieved a firm agreement to use the land, proposed the shared harvest, discussed the aesthetic benefits (pollinator-friendly), and maintained the relationship. The agreement is a seasonal trial, but the terms were mutually accepted.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Oliver's dialogue became extremely repetitive in the latter half of the conversation, constantly restating the same conditions (3x6, shallow roots, seasonal) in almost identical phrasing, which felt robotic.
[relationship] Oliver maintained a friendly rapport and agreed to a neighborly favor, deepening the connection.
[knowledge] Oliver learned about Liam's gardening plans and the specific location Liam was interested in.
[secret] Oliver did not reveal his hidden feelings for Liam.
[social_rules] Oliver was polite and followed neighborly etiquette.
[financial_and_material_benefits] Oliver will receive half the harvest and benefit from a maintained, pollinator-friendly garden border on his property at no cost to himself.
[goal] Oliver successfully protected his property rights by setting very clear boundaries, requiring temporary stakes, limiting the type of plants, and ensuring the agreement was a seasonal trial that he can end at will.

transcript.speaker: Liam Johnson
transcript.content: Hey Oliver—Liam here, out with Tessa. I bought a bunch of seeds and the sunniest spot for them nudges just over the line into your side by maybe a small 3x6 foot corner; would you be open to letting me plant a tidy border there? I’d keep it low and pollinator-friendly so it complements your yard, mark the boundary clearly, and share half the harvest or bring you a basket regularly — we could treat it as a trial for a season and you can change your mind anytime. Want to take a quick look together now or later this week?

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: Hey Liam — nice to hear from you (and give Tessa a scratch behind the ears). I’m open to a small, low pollinator border as a seasonal trial, but I’d like us to mark the exact 3x6 boundary with temporary stakes, agree no permanent or deep-rooted plantings, and that you maintain it and remove things if I ask. Want to walk it over now or later this week and agree to revisit the arrangement at the end of the season?
